sloka: तेषां युद्धं समभवत्सदृशं देवरक्षसाम् ।महेन्द्रस्य च पुत्रस्य राक्षसेन्द्रसुतस्य च ।। ७.२८.९ ॥
transliteration: teṣāṁ yuddhaṁ samabhavatsadṛśaṁ devarakṣasām ।mahendrasya ca putrasya rākṣasendrasutasya ca ।। 7.28.9 ॥

translations.english: A battle then ensued between them, resembling the conflicts of gods and Rakshasas, specifically between Mahendra's son (Jayanta) and the son of the lord of Rakshasas (Meghanada).
